text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The day of the Osaka Hai.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Winning Ticket and Narita Taishin are running too?!
This is gonna be a great race!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
The battle between BNW at the Kikuka Sho
was super intense too, wasn't it?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the stands, many voices rose in anticipation
of the showdown between Winning Ticket and Narita Taishin.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: So many fans called out to me on my way here today.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
That just means everyone has high hopes for it, right?!
For a fiery run... for the best race ever!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Haaah~... Can I really live up to their expectations?
I'm so nervous my whole body is starting to itch...!
choice_data_list: Go out there and bring back the best result!
Go out there and deliver the best result!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Alright, I'm gonna do my best!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"I did my best with training,
so all that's left is pure fighting spirit! Uwoooogh!!"
